blocking_defects.summary: The gate rebuilt only the Research Agent treatment view; a validly rehashed Single-prompt INVERT metric mutation still passed lineage, binding, congruence, and treatment-view checks.
The gate searched visible payloads for stopped-fold tokens but did not require either arm's agent_visible_experiment to equal its bound TreatmentMetricView.
INVERT lineage checked owner names and source refs without requiring the mapped raw value to equal the treatment-view metric.
raw_tool_result_lineage proved packet-to-view consistency, not authenticity of the referenced ResearchToolResult body; correction-v4 uses the honest name raw_packet_to_view_lineage.
